title: Target-Token Asymmetry Can Masquerade As Depth Specialization
abstract: arXiv:2610.19344v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Layer-ablation studies often perturb early or late layers of a language model, compare the damage to prediction on two corpora, and read a larger early-layer effect on one corpus as early-layer specialization for its task. Such a comparison averages over the tokens that each corpus asks the model to predict, and these target tokens differ: math solutions, for example, ask for far more whitespace and numbers than encyclopedia prose. We show that this difference can create the appearance of depth specialization. We split a cross-corpus early--late damage interaction by target-token type and recompute it under a target mixture shared by both corpora. Between GSM8K and Wikitext, a positive interaction replicates across five model instances. In the three fully decomposed models, only whitespace has a positive interaction. Removing whitespace reverses the pooled effect in all three, and matching the full target mixture reverses it in two. The

translated_title: 目标词元不对称性可能伪装成深度专门化
translated_abstract: 层级消融研究通常会扰动语言模型的早期或晚期层，比较其对两个语料库预测造成的损害，并将某一语料库上更大的早期层效应解读为该模型对该任务的早期层专门化。这种比较会对各语料库要求模型预测的词元取平均，而这些目标词元是不同的：例如，数学解答比百科全书散文需要多得多的空白字符和数字。我们证明这种差异可以制造出深度专门化的假象。我们按目标词元类型拆分了跨语料库的早晚期损伤交互作用，并在两个语料库共享的目标词元混合下重新计算。在GSM8K和Wikitext之间，正交互作用在五个模型实例中均得到复现。在三个完全分解的模型中，只有空白字符具有正交互作用。移除空白字符在所有三个模型中反转了汇总效应，而匹配完整的目标词元混合则在两个模型中反转了该效应。
tldr: 层级消融研究中所观察到的“早期层专门化”现象，可能仅仅是两个语料库之间目标词元分布不对称（如数学文本中大量空白字符）所造成的假象，而非真正的深度专门化。
en_tdlr: Apparent early-layer depth specialization in layer-ablation studies can be an artifact of target-token asymmetry between corpora—such as the excess of whitespace tokens in math text—rather than genuine task specialization.
